status: Protocols only; unbound and unexecuted. Bind actual accepted release source/binary/lock and property hashes before issue. Run after production acceptance, never duplicate already issued scripts.

cases.script:
# TH-016: A metal absorbs latent heat while melting without being oxidised
# Candidate experiment; expected observations are not measured results.
register lv3
add v1 Zn 50g @ 400C
heat v1 1kJ
inspect v1
measure v1 thermometer
inspect
cases.original_forecast: The pulse can bring zinc to its melting region and partly melt it; a solid/liquid transition is not by itself a change in oxidation state.

original_criteria.criterion: Identify metallic zinc in both phases near its declared melting transition.
Any oxide formation must have its own oxygen source and reaction accounting; melting alone cannot create ZnO.

changed_source_expectations.property_binding: Actual deployed-source Zn solid heat-capacity curve and declared enthalpy of fusion; freeze those property-byte hashes at binding before issue. Compare latent+sensible energy and source boundary before numeric energy verdict.
changed_source_expectations.scope: Original finite partial-melt forecast and event/owned-phase consistency; no empirical calibration or full mixed-phase thermodynamics claim.

single_changed_source_replay: Only TH016 on the authenticated phase-source release; do not repeat unchanged GS010/KN007/OR006
